description: List the CVEs most likely to be exploited, by EPSS score (the probability of exploitation in the next 30 days), with a verdict on the top score. To rank by composite risk score, call the cve_triage tool.

has_nuclei_template.description: Only CVEs with a Nuclei detection template

in_kev.description: true lists only CVEs in CISA KEV, false only CVEs not in it

include_rejected.description: Also list the CVEs that NVD marks Rejected

known_ransomware.description: Only CVEs whose CISA KEV entry notes known ransomware use

limit.description: How many CVEs to list, highest EPSS first

min_epss.description: Lowest EPSS score, a probability from 0 to 1, e.g. 0.1

product.description: Exact product name as cpe_search lists it, e.g. log4j

vendor.description: Exact vendor name as cpe_search lists it, e.g. apache

name: cve_leading

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.

limit.description: Most items in results: the limit argument, 20 by default.

product_filter_note.description: Present only with a vendor or product filter: such a filter can miss CVEs.

cvss_v3.description: Base score, 0-10. null without a v3 vector.

cvss_v3_source.description: Source: nvd, cna (the CVE's CNA), adp (CISA's ADP) or other (any other source). null if none recorded.

cvss_v4.description: Base score, 0-10. null without a v4 vector.

cvss_v4_source.description: Coded as cvss_v3_source; chosen apart from it.

cwe_id.description: Main CWE, such as CWE-79. Empty when none is known.

cwe_source.description: Source of cwe_id, coded as cvss_v3_source; null if none recorded.

epss_percentile.description: Share of scored CVEs with an equal or lower EPSS score, 0-1. null with epss_score.

epss_score.description: EPSS probability, 0-1, of exploitation in the next 30 days. null if unscored.

kev_date_added.description: YYYY-MM-DD it entered CISA KEV. null if not in KEV or undated.

severity.description: From CVSS v3, else v4, else v2: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, NONE (score 0.0), or UNKNOWN (no CVSS).

summary.description: One sentence: the count, the leading CVE and its EPSS score if any, and how many are in CISA KEV; a fixed no-match sentence when results is empty.

total.description: CVEs that match. Can exceed count: no offset here, so raise limit (max 50) or page with cve_search sort=epss.

verdict.description: Band of the top EPSS score: critical (0.5+), high (0.2+), moderate (0.05+), low (above 0, below 0.05), unknown (top unscored) or none (no results).

title: Leading CVEs by EPSS
